pricing_rules_targets_chk.name: pricing_rules_targets_chk
pricing_rules_targets_chk.value:
(
        ("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'default' and "pricing_rules"."hotel_id" is null and "pricing_rules"."category_id" is null and "pricing_rules"."product_id" is null) or
        ("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'category' and "pricing_rules"."hotel_id" is null and "pricing_rules"."category_id" is not null and "pricing_rules"."product_id" is null) or
        ("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'product' and "pricing_rules"."hotel_id" is null and "pricing_rules"."category_id" is null and "pricing_rules"."product_id" is not null) or
        ("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'hotel' and "pricing_rules"."hotel_id" is not null and "pricing_rules"."category_id" is null and "pricing_rules"."product_id" is null) or
        ("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'hotel_category' and "pricing_rules"."hotel_id" is not null and "pricing_rules"."category_id" is not null and "pricing_rules"."product_id" is null) or
        ("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'hotel_product' and "pricing_rules"."hotel_id" is not null and "pricing_rules"."category_id" is null and "pricing_rules"."product_id" is not null)
      )

purchase_orders_commit_needs_approval_ch.name: purchase_orders_commit_needs_approval_chk
purchase_orders_commit_needs_approval_ch.value: not ("purchase_orders"."status" in ('sent', 'confirmed', 'partially_received', 'received', 'closed')) or ("purchase_orders"."approved_at" is not null and "purchase_orders"."approved_by" is not null)

hub_movements_sign_chk.name: hub_movements_sign_chk
hub_movements_sign_chk.value:
("hub_stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('receipt', 'delivery_return') and "hub_stock_movements"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("hub_stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('dispatch', 'return_to_supplier', 'write_off') and "hub_stock_movements"."quantity" < 0)
        or "hub_stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'adjustment'

credit_notes_issued_chk.name: credit_notes_issued_chk
credit_notes_issued_chk.value: "credit_notes"."status" <> 'issued' or ("credit_notes"."credit_note_number" is not null and "credit_notes"."note_date" is not null)

invoices_issued_fields_chk.name: invoices_issued_fields_chk
invoices_issued_fields_chk.value: "invoices"."status" <> 'issued' or ("invoices"."invoice_number" is not null and "invoices"."invoice_date" is not null and "invoices"."due_date" is not null and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null)

payments_party_chk.name: payments_party_chk
payments_party_chk.value:
("payments"."direction" = 'inbound' and "payments"."hotel_id" is not null and "payments"."supplier_id" is null)
        or ("payments"."direction" = 'outbound' and "payments"."supplier_id" is not null and "payments"."hotel_id" is null)
